caption:
Half of TikTok is taping their mouths shut at night. The research hasn't caught up with the hype.

A 2025 review in PLOS One looked at 10 studies and found no good evidence that mouth taping improves sleep. If your nose blocks in the night, it can be risky.

The boring habits have better backing. A Baylor University study found people who wrote a to-do list before bed fell asleep faster.

Have you tried mouth taping? Did it do anything for you?

Save this for your next 3am wake-up, and send it to the friend who buys every sleep gadget.
